SPARK attended DTF Conference 2026 in Malta

13-14 October 2026 | Valletta Gateway Terminal, Malta

The SPARK team attended DTF Conference 2026 in Valletta, where port, shipping and energy stakeholders met to explore the transition from shore power to integrated energy systems.

During the conference, the team delivered a keynote presentation introducing SPARK and its ambition to provide clean electricity to stationary vessels at anchor. The presentation outlined the Offshore Power Zone concept, the planned pilot outside Skagen and the role of the eight-partner consortium in moving offshore charging from technical concept to live operation.

The keynote also highlighted the wider challenge addressed by SPARK: vessels waiting near shore commonly keep auxiliary engines running to maintain onboard systems. A scalable offshore connection can reduce greenhouse gas emissions, local air pollution and noise while supporting cleaner port and anchorage operations.

DTF Conference 2026 provided an opportunity to share the project with the wider maritime electrification community and connect SPARK's technical work with developments in port energy, wind integration, battery storage and regulatory frameworks.
